paragraphs.text: # [US-AD-095][ILT & vILT] [Class Mgnt] Class Details - Progress & Reports
**Space:** iSuite 2026
**Source:** https://insight.fsoft.com.vn/conf/spaces/ISUITE2026/pages/830569842/US-AD-095+ILT+vILT+Class+Mgnt+Class+Details+-+Progress+Reports
**Jira Ticket:** ISUITE2026-514 (US-AD-095)
## Functional Specifications Requirement
### Objective
| # | Requirement | Notes |
| 1 | Provide an overview dashboard showing **class-level learning performance** | Focus on ILT/vILT class completion and attendance |
| 2 | Display **Class Completion Rate** based on learners completing required learning sessions | Certification is granted when class learning is completed |
| 3 | Display **Attendance Rate** reflecting learners' participation across all required sessions | Core KPI for ILT/vILT classes |
| 4 | Clearly distinguish **class-level completion metrics** from **learner-level completion metrics** | Learner-level metric is named "Learner Completion (%)" |
| 5 | Provide **Assessment Status Overview** to show exam participation and outcomes | Assessment does not affect class completion or certification |
| 6 | Allow admins to **filter assessment analytics by specific exam** within the class | Prevent empty or misleading charts |
| 7 | Visualize **Assessment Performance** using score distribution charts | Used for analytical and instructional insight only |
| 8 | Display **Assessment trend over time** based on selected assessment filter | Supports monitoring learner engagement with exams |
| 9 | Identify and surface **At-Risk Learners** based on attendance, completion, or assessment signals | Risk is informative, not a certification blocker |
| 10 | Provide a **Learner Detail Table** summarizing completion, attendance, assessment status, and score | Supports sorting, scanning, and drill-down |
| 11 | Enable navigation from **Learner Name** to learner-specific assessment details within the class | Context remains at class level |
| 12 | Support **exportable reports (CSV, PDF)** reflecting current dashboard filters | Used for audit, review, and offline analysis |
### Scope Of Work
| # | Scope Of Work | Detail |
| 1 | Class Performance Overview Dashboard | Overview section: completion rate, attendance rate, assessment status, at-risk indicators |
| 2 | Class Completion Rate Calculation & Display | Based on learners completing all required learning sessions. Certification from learning completion, not assessment |
| 3 | Attendance Rate Calculation & Visualization | Overall attendance rate across all required ILT/vILT sessions; visualize trends |
| 4 | Clear Distinction Class-Level vs Learner-Level Metrics | Class Completion Rate (KPI) vs Learner Completion (%) in table |
| 5 | Assessment Status Overview | Passed, Incomplete, Not Attempted — reporting/analytical only |
| 6 | Assessment Filtering by Exam | Filter by selected exam or All Exams; prevent empty charts |
| 7 | Assessment Performance Analytics | Score distribution charts based on filter |
| 8 | Assessment Activity Trend Analysis | Trends over time (submissions/day, avg scores) based on filter |
| 9 | At-Risk Learner Identification | Based on attendance, completion progress, assessment participation |
| 10 | Learner Detail Table | Learner completion (%), attendance (%), assessment score, status |
| 11 | Learner Assessment Drill-down Navigation | From Learner Name → learner-specific assessment detail within same class context |
| 12 | Report Export Functionality | CSV and PDF, reflecting current filters |
## User Story
**As** an Admin
**I want to** view class-level progress, attendance, and assessment reports in a centralized **Progress & Reports** section
**So that** I can monitor learner completion and attendance for certification, analyze assessment outcomes, identify at-risk learners early, and export reports.
## Component Description
| No | EN Component | Type | Mandatory | Description / Rules | Data mapping |
| 1 | Dashboard Title | Display text | Yes | Page title "Progress & Reports". Static, aligned with Class Details nav | — |

| 2 | Assessment Filter | Dropdown | Conditional | Filter analytics by specific exam or All Exams (default). Applies to Status, Performance, Over Time charts. Only published+assigned assessments shown. On change → reload assessment dataset. Edge: no exam → filter empty state; selected exam no submission → empty state | class.assessments.id |

| 3 | Assessment Empty State | Empty state | Conditional | Shown when selected assessment has no submission data. Related charts hidden. Message "No assessment data available for the selected exam". No zero-value charts | assessment.submissions |

| 4 | Assessment Performance | Bar chart | Conditional | Score distribution using predefined buckets (e.g. 0–5, 5–10, >10). Buckets follow assessment max score & grading setup. Rendered only when ≥1 valid score exists. Not for certification | assessment.scores |

| 5 | Assessment Over Time | Line chart | Conditional | Assessment activity trends over time. Metric: number of submissions per day = count(submissions grouped by submission_date) | assessment.submissions.created_at |

| 6 | Assessment Status | Donut/Pie chart | Conditional | Participation status: Passed (submitted, score ≥ passing), Incomplete (submitted, score < passing), Not Attempted (no submission). Informational only. Shown only when ≥1 assessment available | assessment.submissions.status |

| 7 | Learner Completion Rate | KPI Card | Yes | % learners completed class based solely on learning session completion (ILT/vILT attendance). Completed = meets attendance threshold or all mandatory sessions (class config). Exam results excluded. Formula: (completed learners / total enrolled) × 100. total_enrolled=0 → 0% | class.learners.completed_count, class.learners.total |

| 8 | Attendance Rate | KPI Card | Yes | Overall attendance across all required sessions. Formula: attended_sessions / (total_sessions × total_learners) × 100. Cancelled sessions excluded. vILT valid only if participation ≥ configured duration (default 80%). Auto-recalculated | attendance.records |
| 9 | Export Reports | Button group | Conditional | Export as CSV or PDF. Reflects current filters (assessment filter, date range). Authorized roles only | aggregated report data |

| 10 | Learner Detail Table | Data table | Yes | Learner Completion (%), Attendance (%), Score, Assessment Status. Reflects current Assessment Filter. Pagination & sorting. No edit | learner.metrics |

| 11 | Learner Name | Link | Yes | Clickable → Learner Assessment Detail page within same class context. Validates permission (Admin/Instructor). Shows exam list, attempt history, scores, status. Back preserves class context + filter. Not global learner profile | learner.id |

| 12 | Learner Progress (%) | Number | Yes | Individual learner completion % based on learning items/sessions completed within class. Tooltip explains formula, clarifies differs from class completion rate | learner.progress |
| 13 | Learner Attendance (%) | Number | Yes | Attendance % per learner across required sessions. Used as at-risk signal | learner.attendance |
| 14 | Score | Display text | Conditional | Learner's score for selected assessment as X/Y (actual/max). Hidden or "—" if not attempted | assessment.score |

| 15 | Assessment Status (learner) | Status text | Conditional | Learner's status for selected exam: Completed, Incomplete, Not Attempted. Derived from submission+grading, independent of learning completion | assessment.submission.status |
## Acceptance Criteria
| AC# | Given | When | Then | Message |
| AC1 | Admin/Instructor on Class Details | Screen loads | System displays **Progress & Reports** tab | — |
| AC2 | Admin/Instructor on Class Details | Clicks Progress & Reports tab | Dashboard displayed | — |
| AC3 | Class has ≥1 published+assigned assessment | P&R loads | Assessment Filter shown with default **All Exams** | — |
| AC4 | Class has no published assessment | P&R loads | Assessment Filter + all assessment components hidden | — |
| AC5 | Filter = All Exams | Assessment section renders | Status, Performance, Over Time show **aggregated data** | — |
| AC6 | Admin selects specific exam | Filter changes | Status, Performance, Over Time reloaded for selected exam | — |
| AC7 | Selected exam has no submissions | Charts attempt render | All assessment charts hidden + empty state | "No assessment data available for the selected exam." |
| AC8 | Selected exam has ≥1 valid score | Performance renders | Score distribution using predefined buckets | — |
| AC9 | Selected exam has submission history | Over Time renders | Submission trend per day using configured metric | — |
| AC10 | Class has enrolled learners | P&R loads | Learner Completion Rate based only on learning completion | — |
| AC11 | Class has zero enrolled learners | P&R loads | Learner Completion Rate = **0%** | — |
| AC12 | ILT/vILT sessions exist | P&R loads | Attendance Rate from valid records, excluding cancelled sessions | — |
| AC13 | Attendance/sessions updated | User refreshes P&R | Attendance Rate reflects latest data | — |
| AC14 | Learner data exists | P&R loads | Learner Detail Table displayed | — |
| AC15 | Learner completion data exists | Table renders | Learner Progress (%) with correct calculation | — |
| AC16 | Learner attendance data exists | Table renders | Learner Attendance (%) displayed correctly | — |
| AC17 | Admin/Instructor clicks learner name | System validates permission | Navigates to Learner Assessment Detail scoped to same class | — |
| AC18 | Learner Assessment Detail loaded | Learner has assigned exams | Displays exam list, attempts, scores, statuses | — |
| AC19 | On Learner Assessment Detail | User navigates back | Returns to P&R and preserves filter state | — |
